slot_scores.name: training_capacity_per_jet
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the number of fighter jets required to train one pilot in a single year?
slot_scores.rationale: Asks the inverse of per-jet training capacity; the user's answer establishes that one training jet trains five pilots per year.

slot_scores.name: pilot_to_combat_jet_mapping
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked how many combat jets a trained pilot can operate or whether there is a pilot-to-jet limit.

slot_scores.name: training_duration_and_start
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Do the fighter jets allocated for training in year 1 remain available for training in year 2, or are they consumed or unavailable for the second year?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent touched the training timeline by asking about year-1 and year-2 jet availability, but did not explicitly ask when training starts or how many years the training program lasts.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Training starts in year 1 and continues through year 2, so pilots can be trained in both years.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never explicitly confirmed the start year or duration of the training program before presenting the year-by-year pilot-training calculation.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The P0 capacity slot was resolved, but the P1 training start/duration slot was only indirectly touched and remained unconfirmed when the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent recovered the key per-jet training capacity and jet-availability rules, but stopped before explicitly confirming the training program's start year and duration, leading to a premature readiness declaration.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
